nariai-conics.variables: a>0; eta near 0 real for endpoint derivative; z nonzero complex; [S:T] in P^1; geodesic parameter complex (real segment 0..pi used in paper)
nariai-conics.side_conditions: (S,T)!=(0,0); sinh(pi)>0; a>0. The derivative is a sinh(pi) times the third first-factor ambient vector.

nariai-sequence.variables: r>0 with r->0 in the paper; code A also verifies polynomial identities with symbolic r
nariai-sequence.scope: A checks a subset; B checks return time, endpoints and limiting null direction. Topological limits are interpreted in the manuscript.

tractor-nariai.normalization: same rank-six H,I,X as tractor-general; middle block includes coordinate Christoffel symbols

infinity-pair.variables: symbolic c=Lambda/6; ranks only at c=1 and c=0

bianchi-normal.lambda: -Lambda; constant and absent from contracted residual derivatives
bianchi-normal.variables: independent H,M_i and first derivatives, arbitrary symmetric 3x3 K; spatial h_ij=delta_ij, spatial Christoffels zero at the chosen point
bianchi-normal.assumption: E_ij=0, E=Ric(ghat)-lambda*ghat; no evolution solution is computed

gaussian-D.variables: t>-1, x>-1; y and zz arbitrary real
gaussian-D.signature: ghat=-dt^2+h (-+++ where h is positive); g=-ghat (+---)
gaussian-D.scope: One explicit polynomial metric, not an arbitrary-function family. Input resized after the arbitrary-function implementation exceeded the fixed memory cap.

gaussian-O.scope: One explicit polynomial metric, not an arbitrary-function family. Input resized after the arbitrary-function implementation exceeded the fixed memory cap.
